species.tagline: A swallowtail with a glowing blue band

tasks.title: Look at the blue band
tasks.message: A brilliant blue-green band runs across both wings.
tasks.subtitle: Hello! This is a common bluebottle. A blue-green band runs right across its wings.

tasks.title: How fast it flies
tasks.message: It flies fast and straight, and rarely stops.
tasks.subtitle: Bluebottles are fast, straight fliers. Photographing one is hard!

tasks.title: How to help
tasks.message: Flowers and trees are what butterflies feed on.
tasks.subtitle: Butterflies need nectar and leaves. Leaving flowers helps them stay. Thank you!
